name: certificate-check
label: Witness certificate (script + exact cross-check)
description: For search-mode discoveries: turn a witness (an assignment, a coloring, a construction) into a VERIFIED certificate. Provide: the witness JSON, a python `verify(witness) -> bool` script (your checking logic), and optionally an exact expression+predicate cross-check the runner evaluates itself, plus structural constraints (allDistinct, tupleAllPrime). Exit 0 = certificate verified. The runner decides the exit code; passing requires verify() AND every exact/structural check.

inputs.name: witness
inputs.description: the witness as a JSON object (e.g. {"a":27,"b":84,"c":110,"d":133})

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: optional exact cross-check expression over witness variables

inputs.name: predicate
inputs.description: predicate for the cross-check (required with expression)

inputs.name: allDistinct
inputs.description: optional witness keys that must be pairwise distinct

inputs.name: tupleAllPrime
inputs.description: optional witness keys that must all be prime
